policy.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 git ls-tree order rows mode SP type SP blob TAB path LF
policy.default: include every tracked blob and gitlink including source, assets, locks, native, workers, relay, tests, tooling, configuration and all requirements/privacy/research docs
policy.ambiguityPolicy: Conservatively include everything else. Includes parked plans, experimental PRs, supervisor verify documents, generated app SVG/typescript, third party notices and tests; no title-only exclusion. PR158 excluded by its verified 12-file research/prototype scope. Other prototype and watch branches remain included.
policy.comparison: Compare main fingerprint and sorted map PR number -> included head-tree fingerprint, not raw commit alone. Opening/closing relevant PR changes the input set. Completed published baseline required.
